thesis: This episode argues that online advertising is the fundamental engine of the internet economy, enabling platforms like Meta to thrive through AI-driven ranking and personalized ad experiences. It posits that the industry must embrace automated ad campaigns and that personalized ads provide a superior user experience compared to non-personalized alternatives. The discussion highlights Meta's successful disruption by AI systems and its shift toward engaging with unconnected content via content feeds.
